_comment: Regression for HR01: linkRe was constructed with /g flag and called via .test() inside forEachPage. RegExp.test on a global regex advances lastIndex, so pages whose match position is earlier than the accumulated lastIndex were silently skipped. This fixture seeds two pages where the second (alphabetically) has [[bob-jones]] at an offset much smaller than the first page's body length, so the bug deterministically misses the rewrite on the short page.
